findings.label: Commit message vs design wording (non-blocking)
findings.detail: The commit says the Footer links to /docs and /privacy-policy '(both real routes)', which is accurate against the current code but reads as a contradiction of the design doc's stale 'dead route' claim. /privacy-policy exists as a real page in origin/main and the authoritative requirements (FR1.2/AC5) ask for both links, so linking both is correct. The scratchpad already documents the reconciliation. Informational only; no code change required.
